title: Frustrating delay in analysis due to app configuration
summary: I met some analysts this week who described a frustration with Debrief. Each time they start Debrief they have to change the time format from hours and minutes to hours, minutes, seconds. They have had to do this several times a day, every day, for years and years and years. They'd like to know if there's a way of modifying Debrief to allow some default configurations to be used for that analyst. I shared this with the Ed the B, and he suggested "how about they configure an debrief plot file with the settings they like, then add REP files to it". Hmm, I think Debrief may wish to save it instantly, meaning it gets overwritten each time. But, if it was changed to read-only, the user _may_ be invited to save-as somewhere first, such as into their analysis folder. This should allow a range of preferences, plus grid/scale/backdrop as required.
